caption: The drawing depicts a piece of wooden furniture, possibly a couch or chaise lounge, with a curved headrest to the right in brown and reddish tones. Draped over the furniture is a white cloth covered in diagonal red and brown striped patterns, interspersed with green and gold abstract floral shapes. Partially under the striped cloth on the left side is an additional layer of textile, light gray with fine, dark looping lines. In the bottom left corner, a brown area with a swirling, shell-like pattern appears, bordered by a red, jagged edge and decorated with stylized yellow, pink, and orange flowers with green leaves. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
